title.zh: 从零光锥出发的引力代数量子化
title.en: An algebraic quantization of gravity from the null cone

summary.zh: alphaXiv 首页最前的一篇偏理论物理的论文，作者 Venkatesa Chandrasekaran（Stanford），首页标注约 5,000 次浏览。论文提出对四维洛伦兹时空真空广义相对论的背景无关量子化：在零光锥上解出引力约束，构造有限 G_N 下的约化相空间和可观测量代数，并在此基础上得到每一步求和都绝对收敛的洛伦兹路径积分，给出引力子对产生湮灭振幅的有限闭式。与智能体关系不大，列入只因为它是首页热度最高。摘要依据 arXiv 公开摘要。
summary.en: First on the alphaXiv homepage and a theoretical-physics paper by Venkatesa Chandrasekaran (Stanford), with about 5,000 views listed. It proposes a background-independent quantization of vacuum general relativity on four-dimensional Lorentzian spacetimes: solve the gravitational constraints on null cones, build the reduced phase space and an algebra of observables at finite G_N, and obtain a Lorentzian path integral in which every sum over intermediate states converges absolutely, with a finite closed-form amplitude for graviton pair creation and annihilation. It has little to do with agents; it is listed only because it is the most-viewed on the homepage. Based on the public arXiv abstract.

title.zh: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer（循环混合 Transformer）
title.en: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer

summary.zh: 字节 Seed 与多伦多大学的论文，作者含 Lianghui Zhu、Shijie Wang、Xinggang Wang，首页标注约 963 次浏览。循环 Transformer 复用共享层以增强表达力但损失效率；这篇提出用 KV 作为跨深度、跨循环的选择性复用记忆（MoLA），并给出 U 形变体，让每个生成 token 只需一次遍历，延迟与标准 Transformer 相当。摘要称在 400B token 预训练中，U-MoLT 在 700M/1.5B 稠密和 3B MoE 模型上都优于 OLMo3。摘要依据 arXiv 公开摘要，未补充其他数字。
summary.en: A ByteDance Seed and University of Toronto paper whose authors include Lianghui Zhu, Shijie Wang and Xinggang Wang, with about 963 views listed. Looped Transformers reuse shared layers for expressivity at the cost of efficiency; this paper uses KV as selectively reused memory across depths and loops (MoLA) and adds a U-shaped variant so each generated token needs one traversal, matching a standard Transformer’s latency. The abstract says U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models in 400B-token pretraining. Based on the public arXiv abstract; no other figures added.

title.zh: 递归的集体智能：同等预算梯子上的多智能体涌现
title.en: Recursive Collective Intelligence: Emergence on an Equal-Budget Ladder in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

summary.zh: 上期已覆盖的多智能体论文，今天排在首页第三，作者含 Lixuan He、Shengqu Cai 和李飞飞，约 2,000 次浏览。论文用「同等预算梯子」在对齐计算量的条件下，衡量群体互动是否强于单个智能体、多数投票和 pass@n，以及群体能否用自己已验证的工作改进下一代；首页简介强调，当智能体共享彼此没有的事实时，能解决独立采样解决不了的问题。摘要依据首页介绍，未编造实验数字。
summary.en: The multi-agent paper covered last time, now third on the homepage; the authors include Lixuan He, Shengqu Cai and Li Fei-Fei, with about 2,000 views. It uses an equal-budget ladder, with compute aligned, to test whether group interaction beats a single agent, majority vote and pass@n, and whether a group can improve its next generation from its own verified work; the homepage blurb stresses that agents sharing facts the others lack can solve problems beyond independent sampling. Based on the homepage blurb; no experimental figures invented.

summary.zh: 11 月 28 日 08:21（北京时间）发布 v2026.12.1-beta.1 预发布。亮点：Git 安装用准备好的发行版和常驻启动器，包更新时不停止运行中的 Gateway；压缩跨路由复用热提示缓存，自动压缩在上下文窗口 85% 时触发；可从 Agent 菜单分享模板、在聊天卡片里管理计划中的自动化；Session Share 通过出站 WSS 拉取被授权共享的会话；Gateway 共享核心 worker 代码并按内存预算放行 worker，缓解小机器内存压力；ClawHub 技能目录支持分类浏览和搜索。同时新增 Cloudflare Access JWT 校验（可选）、Slack 知识读取、`/codex review` 指定分支或提交，并把内置 Codex app-server 更新到 0.172.0。最新稳定功能版仍是 11 月 25 日的 v2026.11.10，11 月 26 日的 v2026.10.34 为 Gateway 扩展稳定补丁线。
summary.en: v2026.12.1-beta.1 was published as a pre-release at 08:21 Beijing time on November 28. Highlights: Git installs use prepared releases and a resident launcher, and package updates prepare without stopping the serving Gateway; compaction reuses the warm prompt cache across routes, with automatic compaction at 85% of the context window; agents can be shared as templates from their menu and planned automations managed from chat cards; Session Share pulls authorized shared sessions over outbound WSS; Gateways share core worker code and admit workers within a memory budget to ease small-machine memory pressure; the ClawHub skill catalog can be browsed and searched by category. It also adds opt-in Cloudflare Access JWT verification, Slack reading through Knowledge, `/codex review` for a branch or commit, and updates the bundled Codex app-server to 0.172.0. The latest stable feature release is still v2026.11.10 from November 25; v2026.10.34 on November 26 is the Gateway-only extended-stable patch line.

text.zh: 今日重心（周六去敏）：以家庭陪伴为主。陪大宝的英语（新课预习、单词默写、周末作业与错题订正，晚上 19 点有一节语法课）和语文（日记、课后习题、生词听写、好书共读），陪小宝（围棋对弈、英语练习册与视频课），并检查课内记事本。学习与工作侧：继续技术文章阅读、研究 pstack/superpower，流式语音识别接入仍是最高优先事项，另有一项面试题准备和通识课（万维钢思考工具）需要推进。今天周六无训练安排，天气晴、午后阵风 5 级，户外注意防风。
text.en: Saturday focus (sanitized): mostly family time. Help the older child with English (new-lesson preview, word dictation, weekend homework and correcting mistakes, with a grammar class at 19:00) and Chinese (diary, post-lesson exercises, vocabulary dictation, shared reading), help the younger child (Go games, English workbook and video lesson), and check the in-class notebook. On the learning and work side: keep up technical-article reading and the pstack/superpower study; streaming speech-recognition integration remains the top priority; there is also interview-question prep and the general-education course (Wan Weigang’s thinking tools) to move forward. No training today (Saturday); it is sunny with force-5 gusts in the afternoon, so dress for wind outdoors.
